##### Project general facts

Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22 is a masterpiece of waterfront development, expertly blending elegant interiors, breathtaking canal views, and the allure of hotel-branded living. This refined residential destination seamlessly merge comfort, luxury, and investment potential, making it a haven for discerning end-users and astute investors seeking a distinctive lifestyle by the water. The development's design showcases sophisticated glass towers, redefining waterfront living with an emphasis on unobstructed canal vistas and serene sea views.

The residences within Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22 boast premium finishes and are fully furnished, ensuring a turnkey living experience that epitomizes effortless luxury. High-end brands such as The One Furniture, Hansgrohe, Siemens, Samsung, and Otis have been meticulously selected to fit out the kitchens and interiors, delivering a symphony of quality, style, and functionality. Each residence has been crafted to provide a comfortable and elegant home environment, where sophisticated materials and clever design converge to create a sense of refined sophistication.

The overall design of Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22 emphasizes architectural clarity, with fully glazed façades that maximize natural light and frame the surrounding scenery, creating a calm and visually immersive environment centered around water, space, and serenity. The development's focus on comfort and luxury is evident in the attention to detail and the commitment to delivering a truly exceptional living experience, where every aspect of the residences has been carefully considered to provide a sense of refined elegance and poise.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Raha Beach is a captivating waterfront destination that embodies the essence of luxury and tranquility, nestled along the pristine shores of Abu Dhabi. This master-planned community seamlessly blends residential, commercial, and recreational elements in a harmonious coastal setting, redefining modern living with its stunning architecture, top-notch amenities, and panoramic views. The community's wealth of world-class facilities, including pristine beaches, exclusive gyms, and sports centers, cater to the diverse interests and preferences of its residents, while lush parks and landscaped areas provide serene spots for relaxation and socializing.

Al Raha Beach stands as a testament to Abu Dhabi's cosmopolitan charm, offering a lifestyle of opulence and tranquility that reflects the pinnacle of modern living. The community's exclusive clubhouse, retail outlets, and swimming pools, as well as its abundance of dining choices, landscaped lawns, and peaceful water fountains, all contribute to a sense of refined sophistication and elegance. As a destination for unparalleled leisure and recreation, Al Raha Beach invites residents to unwind by the water's edge, pursuit their passions, and indulge in the finer things in life.

The prestige and allure of Al Raha Beach are further enhanced by its four standout locations: Al Bandar, Al Hadeel, Al Muneera, and Al Zeina, each offering a unique character and charm that contributes to the community's overall sense of luxury and refinement. With its stunning natural beauty, world-class amenities, and sophisticated lifestyle, Al Raha Beach is a true gem of Abu Dhabi, a place where residents can experience the very best of modern living in a setting of unparalleled elegance and poise.
